audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side rows disagreed with content win[N]: the full layer read LeBlanc on levels 1-5 and Skill from 6 onward, the exact inverse of the content chart and packet.levelChart.
audit.why: The content chart is right and the full layer was reversed. Level 1 LeBlanc has one spell and Sigil of Malice needs a second cast to detonate, so Orianna wins it; the lane goes even through 5; Mimic at 6 and the Luden's window belong to LeBlanc; two items favours grouped Orianna.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved onto the content chart and every why rewritten to match its new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose gave no cooldown for the ability the whole matchup revolves around.
audit.why: Distortion is 15s at rank 1 down to 10s at rank 5, 600 range, with a 4-second return window. Mimic is 45/35/25. Those two numbers set every commit window in the lane.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into the level 6, first item and cooldown fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect says this matchup never names any LeBlanc ability beyond Distortion; breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; two bullet bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pastes.
audit.why: Sigil of Malice (6s, 700 range) marks for 3.5 seconds and detonates when any of her abilities damages the marked target — that mark is the burst. Ethereal Chains (14s at rank 1, 925 range) only roots if the shackle survives 1.5 seconds, so opening the distance denies the root. Mirror Image triggers below 40% health for 1 second of invisibility plus an 8-second clone that deals no damage.
audit.corrected: Sigil of Malice, Ethereal Chains, Mimic and Mirror Image now appear by name with their real numbers.
All flagged fields rewritten with she/her.
